messages:
mira: Noticed duplicate billing and 20x short streams during canary. Correlated with clients sending Conn-Update immediately after token rotate.

dylan: console shows resume spike at 09:05 UTC. Likely race: Conn-Update vs edge sticky-lease refresh.

sam: quick repro?

mira: curl repro: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer X" -H "Conn-Update: id=tenantX;seq=2" https://stream.redwood/api/events

dylan: timeline: new conn accepted -> old conn closed ~15ms later -> billing recorded for both. Aggregator window too small.

mira: proposal: feature-flagged server debounce 250ms + metric conn_update_debounced. Also group UI sessions within 2s to reduce noise.

sam: add unit + integ test for auth jitter + sticky lease delay.

console-ui: will add grouped-session toggle and a deduped-billing panel.

ops-bot: scheduled canary flag rollout conn_update_debounce_ms=250 at 10:30 UTC. Watch metrics: conn_update_debounced, deduped_billing_count, grouped_session_count.
